genome.title: Genome
genome.description: Biological source of DNA specimen analyzed by MADDD-seq

min_reads.title: Minimum Number of Reads
min_reads.description: The minimum number of sequence reads required for each individual DNA strand.

trim_length.title: 5' Trim Length
trim_length.description: The number of bases to trim from the 5' end of each read.

min_base_prop.title: Minimum Consensus Threshold
min_base_prop.description: The proportion of reads required to call a consensus base at each position of the SSC.

min_qvalue.title: Minimum Quality Score
min_qvalue.description: Any bases below this minimum quality score will be trimmed from the 3' end of each read.

min_align_score.title: Minimum Alignment Score
min_align_score.description: The minimum number of bases required for a sequence read to align to the reference genome.

filter_on.title: Fragment Filtering Logic
filter_on.description: When filtering fragments by the maximum number of variants, optionally include adducts.

RD1_ADAPTER_3P.title: Read 1 Adapter
RD1_ADAPTER_3P.description: Adapter sequence used for trimming read 1

RD2_ADAPTER_3P.title: Read 2 Adapter
RD2_ADAPTER_3P.description: Adapter sequence used for trimming read 2

schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per specimen, with its pair of R1 and R2 FASTQ files. Each specimen can be listed only once, so combine the FASTQ files of a specimen sequenced on several lanes before running.

specimen.title: Specimen
specimen.errorMessage: Specimen names can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores

R1.title: FASTQ (R1)
R1.errorMessage: Must be a read FASTQ (.fq, .fastq, .fq.gz or .fastq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

R2.title: FASTQ (R2)
R2.errorMessage: Must be a read FASTQ (.fq, .fastq, .fq.gz or .fastq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read
